options.text: The screw is made of a magnetic material; the spoon is not.
The spoon is made of a magnetic material; the screw is not.
Both are magnetic because Nidhi used a bar magnet near them.
Both are non-magnetic because only one object moved.

stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet, an iron screw, and an aluminium spoon. Nidhi brings the magnet near each object. The screw is attracted. The spoon is not.

Which conclusion is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: A magnet attracts magnetic materials. The iron screw is attracted, so it is magnetic. The aluminium spoon is not attracted, so it is non-magnetic.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source magnets/iron-rod figure into bar magnet with iron screw and aluminium spoon.
